./.github/actions/plan-ci.digest_serialization: Compact JSON is jq -c output from ci-plan.json; SHA-256 is computed over its exact UTF-8 bytes without a trailing newline via printf '%s' | sha256sum. No added digest fields or serialization are implied.
./.github/actions/plan-ci.upload: Optional ci-plan.json artifact, only when upload_artifact=true, caller-supplied artifact_name nonempty, retention 1 day; normal PR/main lanes pass plan over native outputs, not an artifact.

./.github/actions/compute-changes.absence: Unknown event fails; malformed/missing push diff identity forces __force_all__; PR uses base...head; dispatch sets __force_all__.

./.github/actions/capture-sccache-stats.artifact: Unique caller-provided artifact_name, JSON evidence, retention 14 days; non-green if a configured warm threshold is unmet.

artifact_and_archive_rules.identity: GitHub artifact names are explicit and encode platform, architecture, backend, or run ID as shown above. Downloads consume the named artifact in the same workflow run. Workflow lane `needs` gates prevent product and smoke consumers from running after failed producers; consumers do not rebuild missing producers.
artifact_and_archive_rules.retention: Routine CI product/UI/host/runtime/static-ABI/SDK artifacts request 1 day. Linux native runtime-event evidence is 7 days. sccache evidence is 14 days. Unspecified upload retention is unknown here and inherits GitHub repository configuration; do not infer a value. Release artifacts use workflow inputs and release policy, not this CI default.
artifact_and_archive_rules.serialization: SHA-256 sidecars are lowercase digest, two spaces, basename, newline except Windows PowerShell host sidecar uses Set-Content -NoNewline. Product/runtime/static ABI tar.gz files are payloads, not proof of the artifact-service container. upload-artifact v6.0.0 SHA b7c566a772e6b6bfb58ed0dc250532a479d7789f and download-artifact v8.0.1 SHA 3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c are the common pins; isolated v7.0.0/v4.3.0 call sites also exist. Source manifests expose defaults including include-hidden-files=false, compression-level=6 and skip-decompress=false, but do not prove GitHub service archive encoding, executable mode restoration or symlink behavior. Those transport semantics remain externally unverified.
artifact_and_archive_rules.safe_extraction: scripts/safe-extract-tar.py rejects absolute/drive/traversal paths, duplicate paths, unsupported members, escaping links and overwrites. It creates directories, regular files and symlinks/hardlinks after validating paths; on non-Windows it restores member permission bits masked with 0777. Windows does not chmod. Host is chmod +x during composition/staging. Product smoke rejects symlink manifest paths and top-level links. Release UI distribution stamp/verify rejects all symlinks.
artifact_and_archive_rules.archive_byte_identity: Composition verifies input checksum and runtime manifest, then archives composed directory. Exact producer bytes are copied; tar container byte reproducibility, mtime normalization, uid/gid normalization, compression determinism, and Actions artifact transport preservation of mode/symlink metadata are not asserted by the checked-in producer workflows. Mark those aspects unknown rather than relying on an assumed tar implementation guarantee.

product_readiness.cwd: inherits job working directory; CI composer calls from workspace root
product_readiness.ports: Reserves a free 127.0.0.1 TCP port, passes --port and --no-console; mdns discovery is selected. No fixed service port is needed.
product_readiness.ready_condition: JSON line with event=passive_mode, status=ready, role=client, or legacy message containing client ready.
product_readiness.cleanup: EXIT trap sends SIGTERM on Unix, CTRL_BREAK_EVENT on Windows, waits bounded time then force-kills, removes private state directory and log. A shutdown timeout/nonzero exit or cleanup deletion failure returns nonzero.

two_node_split.cwd: workspace checkout; evidence work directory may be runner.temp
two_node_split.coverage: Dense leg followed by optional recurrent leg in the same job. The CI caller supplies strict recurrent exact payload kind kv-recurrent and context 4096. Evidence is uploaded on success or failure when named.
two_node_split.cleanup: Script registers EXIT cleanup, kills tracked client/worker/seed process trees (TERM, one-second wait, KILL), prints log tails and removes default-created work/process dirs. Explicit WORK_DIR/PROCESS_ROOT overrides are retained. CI sets WORK_DIR under runner.temp for evidence preservation and leaves PROCESS_ROOT default. No explicit INT/TERM/HUP traps; SIGKILL or runner loss can bypass cleanup. Upload runs on success/failure but not cancellation and if-no-files-found=error. Cleanup is best effort.

bootstrap.native: Repository .cargo/config.toml mandates rustc-wrapper=sccache and target linker scripts. Linux runner image preflight is verify-runner-image public cpu; macOS host/runtime runs setup-macos-lld (brew lld and sccache, then scripts/cargo-linker --mesh-probe); Windows host/runtime uses setup-windows-short-paths and Windows Rust/MSVC prerequisites. External live runner availability is not probed by this task.

linkers.linux: scripts/cargo-linker-linux-x86_64 or -aarch64, mold preferred with compatible lld/platform fallback per checked-in CI docs
linkers.macos: scripts/cargo-linker; Homebrew ld64.lld probe with Apple ld fallback for SDK incompatibility

bootstrap.native_runtime_toolchains: Linux runtime rows use prebuilt backend-specific image and verify-runner-image. macOS uses Xcode/clang/CMake/Ninja and lld setup. Windows installs selected CUDA/Vulkan/ROCm SDK and MSVC as needed. Actual external machine linker state: unverified.
bootstrap.ui: Independent UI artifact job runs in crates/mesh-llm-ui. package.json pins pnpm@10.34.5, Node >=24, pnpm >=10; pnpm i --frozen-lockfile then pnpm run build (tsc -b && vite build). CI UI job uses image-baked pnpm store; no shared pnpm Actions cache. UI stamp inputs in scripts/build-ui.sh are package.json, pnpm-lock.yaml, vite.config.ts, tsconfig files, biome.json, index.html, src and public; env stamp includes profile, debug-ui and Vite base/router/storage namespace values.
bootstrap.lean_ui_split: ci-ui-artifact-slice produces one immutable dist artifact per selected platform lane. Host jobs download it, assert dist/index.html exists, and call prepare-host-input with skip_ui=true, preventing host rebuild from rerunning pnpm/tests. Rust tests use an explicit tiny index.html placeholder. UI behavioral tests remain owned by Website lane.

process_contracts.cleanup_failure_outcome: Non-green: client readiness cleanup explicitly returns failure on failed deletion/shutdown; self-hosted workflow cleanup contract requires bounded cleanup and failure is not green. Two-node process kill operations ignore kill errors; directory removal failure can fail cleanup. Runner loss/force termination can prevent cleanup and evidence upload.

CUDA packaged dependency closure and device probes
coverage.sdk_protocol: Linux Rust and Kotlin smoke; macOS Swift smoke. Product smoke exercises OpenAI client/API path. Explicit protocol test-family coverage is selected by planner/Rust batches; this contract does not establish every protocol crate-to-artifact edge.
coverage.constrained_stack: Linux CPU core smoke runs both dense and recurrent constrained-Tokio restarts with MESH_TOKIO_STACK_SIZE=2097152 bytes (2 MiB), overriding the documented 8 MiB runtime default.
coverage.dense_recurrent: Linux CPU two-node row uses SmolLM2 Q8 dense and IBM Granite 4.0 H Q4 recurrent fixtures; recurrent expected exact payload kind is kv-recurrent, context 4096. Distinct model-server and topology snapshots are reconciled before success.
coverage.windows_readiness: Windows host/product composed readiness uses same composer contract and cross-platform client readiness helper, including native process helper for CTRL_BREAK_EVENT; no live Windows runner execution was performed.

negative_scenarios.condition: Named artifact is expired/unavailable at download (routine producer retention is 1 day).

negative_scenarios.condition: Readiness process fails bounded graceful shutdown or private temp cleanup fails; self-hosted job cleanup reports failure.
negative_scenarios.outcome: Non-green; preserve failure logs/evidence when upload is possible. A runner lost before cleanup is an unresolved infrastructure failure, never a successful cleanup claim.

reachability.method: Manual source trace of required PR/main/manual lane artifact edges and checked-in release, smoke, canary, nightly, cleanup and Pages upload/download actions; reconciled names, called workflows, action inputs and consumer job needs. No external dispatch or live GitHub mutation.
reachability.reached_chain: Required Linux/macOS/Windows chain is UI -> host; independent runtime; host+runtime -> product; product -> smoke. Linux static ABI -> Rust tests and Kotlin producer. SDK smoke downloads product and UI. Linux sdk needs runtime_product+kotlin_sdk_input and macOS sdk needs validate_plan+runtime_product+swift_sdk_input, but neither declares ui_artifact directly despite nested sdk-smoke downloading that artifact. These are missing direct needs edges, not compliant edges. Products declare host/runtime needs; summaries need top-level calls. Consumers do not rebuild missing producer inputs.
reachability.result: Producer/consumer needs reconciliation is complete for required product, SDK and smoke flows and checked-in release/auxiliary artifact flows. Two missing direct SDK UI needs edges are recorded as discrepancies; current workflows are not claimed to satisfy the dependency contract. Archive transport, effective default retention, live runner state and Windows QA remain externally unverified.
unresolved_edges: Exact GitHub artifact-service transport container and executable mode, permissions, symlink and hidden-file preservation/materialization are externally unverified; pinned action inputs alone do not prove service semantics.
Uploads without retention-days have effective retention determined by live GitHub repository/org settings, not inspected here; no value asserted.
Missing direct UI needs: ci-linux-lane.yml sdk and ci-macos-lane.yml sdk consume UI through nested sdk-smoke download without ui_artifact in direct needs; recorded but not changed per task scope.
